account: Researchers at IIT Hyderabad propose a network-management approach that adjusts the instances of a 5G network slice as load changes. In the 2025 ITU entry, current as of June 2025, they state that the implementation plan is in progress and that synthetic data will be used to train the machine learning models. They list no testbed or pilot deployment and supply no testbed result. They name improved resilience and support for smart-city services as intended applications. The ITU interim report of 2026 has no entry on this project. Two of the IIT Hyderabad authors published a paper on cross-slice anomaly detection on 27 October 2025, which concerns a different topic.
